criteria.description: ADR 2026-11-08-2-work-package-windows-are-recorded-at-the-opening-transition records where the window-open SHA lives, the typed gap, the claim inputs and their sources, the durability horizon, the fallback, the nine notions and the named residuals, amending 2026-10-04-5 and 2026-09-29-1.
criteria.notes: Status Proposed; the operator accepts it on the PR. Amendment pointers in both amended ADRs.

criteria.description: Every non-migration move of a lane-mapped work package into claimed or in_progress records policy_metadata.wp_window.open_sha equal to lane_head, from the one lane-head reading.
criteria.notes: WP07 88e2f4fafe. Planning lane, migration actor and blocked write nothing (same file).

criteria.description: A capture that cannot read the lane head records gap lane_branch_missing (no cause) or capture_failed with cause git_error/probe_error, and the move still succeeds.
A window opener without the key reads as gap not_recorded, per event, so a log straddling the upgrade still consolidates.
policy_metadata.wp_window.open_sha is classified BRANCH_RELATIVE in DOSSIER_SHA_FIELDS and the SHA-provenance gate passes.
A spec-kitty-events issue asks the Java write service to write, preserve and type the key, and the ADR links it.
criteria.evidence: spec-kitty/spec-kitty-events#229 (filed 2026-11-08, follow-up comment 1 posted); draft follow-up kitty-specs/consolidation-window-provenance-01M6Y84D/research/events-229-follow-up.md (not posted) @ 8c9c7f46db
criteria.notes: The draft clarifies written vs reader-only gap reasons; posting needs operator authorization.

criteria.description: On a code lane with a recorded window, a commit outside every approved window and every exemption anchor refuses LANE_MOVED_AFTER_APPROVAL naming the commit and the work package approved before it; own-lane stamps do not exempt, other lanes' stamps do (dependency chain).
criteria.notes: NFR-002 (a), (a mixed), (b); SC-001. WP19 red eca56240cd / fix c292b5c85d; canceled exemption 6ddddfcab4 / 8e00363221.

criteria.description: A lane whose commits all lie inside approved windows (reviewer fix during review, rework before re-approval) raises no window refusal on the FR-007 fixture minus the stray commit.
A work package with a window gap is judged by the approval-stamp bound from the claim base and never refused for the gap alone.
Fresh run, resume and forecast (human and --json window_gaps) list every work package judged by the fallback with its gap reason, also before a refusal.
criteria.evidence: tests/consolidation/test_window_gap_report_entry_points.py (fresh, resume, dry-run human/JSON, refusal-first, capture_failed cause, single_branch) @ 8c9c7f46db
criteria.notes: WP20 red 799b52017c / fix 77035f3f53; orchestrator-api envelope unchanged (named residual).

criteria.description: A single_branch Mission uses the recorded window-open SHA when present and keeps today's derivation, reported as a gap, when absent.
Forecast, fresh run and resume obtain claim inputs from one constructor (claim_inputs.build_claim) with sources LIVE, LIVE_THEN_SAVED and SAVED.
On an unmutated state the forecast and the fresh run have equal claim inputs (excluded set, coordination base SHA, status dir) and the same claim-time verdict.
criteria.notes: NFR-002 (h), WP17 red a182b53e3e / fixes 0537aab8cf, cd58516209. Residual: pre-seed status dir (strict xfail test_pre_seed_forecast_status_dir_and_coord_base_equal_fresh_run).

criteria.description: A history-read error in the authored-content walk refuses the claim naming the path and error before any branch moves, while a genuine deletion is still recorded.
On --resume the closed world, the approved bound, the fully-canceled-lane check and the approved-reviewed attestation read one frozen claim-time anchor set.
criteria.notes: NFR-002 (e), (f); (g) recorded unreachable; WP18 reds 0f708b288c, dd46d3e627, 6704f4158b / fix 002391a4cd.

criteria.description: A characterization corpus over mode x lane shape x stamp state x window state records today's verdicts and lands before any code moves; every later change is a named cell.
criteria.evidence: tests/consolidation/test_reconciliation_characterization.py::test_verdict_corpus_matches_the_golden_file; golden diff vs Phase 3 tip 0485b8b4ab maps fully to NFR-002 (a)-(f) plus WP19's two added ruling cells @ 8c9c7f46db

criteria.description: A table-driven pin of the claim-time refusal text and order for every co-occurring refusal pair, with witnesses and a swapped-order control, lands before any code moves.
Every name importable from the reconciliation module, and each name's object identity, is pinned before any code moves; a removed name fails.
reconciliation.py is a re-exporting facade (no def/class) over one module per check, a kernel, the verifier and claim orchestration; each module <= 1,200 lines and imports alone.
criteria.notes: NFR-003: largest module 961 lines; facade 253 lines, 0 def/class. WP10-WP15.

criteria.description: Every test that replaces a reconciliation-family name replaces it where it is looked up, guarded by a check that fails on a stale or narrowed patch.
A window opens at the first non-migration claimed/in_progress move after the last non-review return to planned, skipping leading lane_branch_missing openers, topology order with log-order fallback.
criteria.notes: NFR-002 (c) lanes. Review-rejection keeps the window: an interpretation the operator may overturn.

criteria.description: A recorded SHA that does not resolve or is not on the lane is gap not_on_lane, never a probe error, judged against the one lane tip the bound resolves on every path.
A lane on which every approved work package has a window gap is judged by today's approval-stamp check unchanged, verdict and text byte-identical.
criteria.notes: WP19, by construction (check_lane with today's anchors).
